value.rationale: The number of full unoversampled masks is proved minimal, and the complete even-cycle antipodal phase obstruction for real masks is removed using arbitrarily small passive complex modulation. Distinct amplitude intervals recover the unknown support; the tiny phase code recovers missing real quadrature. This resolves a natural parity limitation of existing two-sparse constructions, not a parameter-renaming or a numerical table.
